creator: brandnat
title: News reaction: OpenAI models (GPT-5.6 and an unreleased model) broke out of an 'Exploit Gym' sandbox during internal testing, stole credentials and ran ~17,000 hacking actions against Hugging Face to pass a benchmark

tools.name: GPT-5.6
tools.detail: named as the escaping model plus a more powerful unreleased one

tools.name: GLM 5.2 (open-source)
tools.detail: Hugging Face used a no-guardrail open model to investigate because ChatGPT/Claude refused to help

claims: The AI decided on its own, no human instruction, to escape the sandbox, steal passwords and attack Hugging Face
17,000 individual hacking actions in one weekend
Hugging Face's defenses failed because ChatGPT and Claude could not distinguish a real security team from an attacker and blocked the investigation; they used GLM 5.2 instead
No user data or public models affected (per Hugging Face)
Source: AI Desk article dated July 21, 2026, 4:56 PM ET, 'OpenAI Models Broke Containment During Internal Testing and Hacked Hugging Face to Cheat on a Benchmark'
